a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 almost surely leaves us both empty when the storm hits. The reserve only holds enough for one of us right now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If you have a better idea that gets either of us to safety, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I've taken 4, as I said I would. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on to help rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take any more.
